prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — flea-ridden (a.布满跳蚤的): A dog scratching its fur with a small magnified inset of one flea; no exaggerated infestation.
TOP RIGHT — coarse (a.粗劣的): A coarse burlap sack with visibly rough loosely woven fibres beside a small smooth cloth swatch.
BOTTOM LEFT — boast (v.自恃有): A proud village host gesturing toward the village's fine stone bridge.
BOTTOM RIGHT — parishioner (n.教区居民): A small group of ordinary residents entering their local parish church.
CROP SAFETY: all subjects within central 65% of each quadrant, no elements cross horizontal or vertical midlines. Bottom scenes begin below 58% total height. Sparse detail, generous white margins.
review_notes: Inspected atlas: planned subjects and curriculum senses are identifiable, anatomy acceptable, no unintended labels; all four illustrations fit their crop cells.
